bodyPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: production sprite animation sheet for a TOP-DOWN 2D pixel RPG.
Image 1: existing approved White Knight animation sheet, character/camera/action reference to expand. Image 2: approved idle stance and exact costume. Change only temporal resolution and smoothness, not the character design.
Primary request: redraw this action as TWELVE genuinely distinct, closely spaced animation poses for EACH of THREE map directions, total EXACTLY 36 isolated sprites.
OUTPUT GRID MUST BE EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS BY SIX ROWS of equal square cells, preferably 1536x1536. No margins outside grid, no text or grid lines. Every sprite has 12% transparent padding within its cell.
Reading order: rows 1+2 = DOWN-facing frames 01..12, row1 columns1..6 frames01..06, row2 columns1..6 frames07..12. Rows3+4 = RIGHT-facing frames01..12. Rows5+6 = UP-facing/back view frames01..12. Do NOT use six different facings. The second row in each pair CONTINUES THE SAME animation, it does not restart.
Camera fixed HIGH OVERHEAD 65-degree orthographic: large visible flat helmet roof, top planes of shoulder armour, short foreshortened boots, cape on ground plane. Up-facing sprites show the back and roof of helmet and cape, NEVER face/visor. Not a tall portrait, side-scrolling character, or isometric pedestal.
Preserve ivory sealed great helm, dark narrow visor, gold/bronze thorn crown, ivory plate with old gold edging/cross marks, dark mail joints, white-feathered quiver, ragged ivory cape with dark-rust hem, recurved bow and straight sword. No redesign, no horse, shield, bare face or extra limbs. Hand-crafted crisp pixel clusters, restrained 3-4 value steps, warm dark contours. No painterly noise or blur.
CRUCIAL TEMPORAL CONSISTENCY: fixed character scale and a common foot/hips map pivot at (50%,68%) in every cell. Helmet and torso must not randomly shift position or change proportions. Do not independently enlarge crouching or fallen poses. Sequential poses are small anatomically plausible increments, not unrelated illustrations. Cape lags gently, no extreme cape flapping or random size changes. Draw in-between arm/leg positions, not repeated/rotated/zoomed copies. No ground, shadow, effects, labels, watermarks, outlines of cells, or background. Genuinely transparent alpha.
The twelve sequential poses for EACH direction:

export.resampling: nearest-neighbour, preserve generated alpha; fixed scale and pivot, no repainting
export.registration: One median vertical packing offset per source grid row; idle/walk also use one shared horizontal packing correction per source column across all facings. One rest-pose-to-idle transform per action/facing, held for all twelve poses. No per-frame rescaling, warping or synthesized poses.

assets.name: Burdened vigil
assets.subject: A seamless restrained breathing loop with FEET FIRMLY PLANTED, sword held low in the same hand and bow low in the other. Poses1..6 slowly inhale through 6 tiny chest/shoulder rises, 7..12 exhale smoothly back toward pose1; total helmet displacement <= TWO logical pixels at 128px sprite size, total cape edge sway <= THREE logical pixels. No steps, turning, arm swings, crown bobbing or major weapon movement. Keep cape cross marks fixed on the same cloth. Frame12 differs only slightly from frame1 so the loop has no pop. Keep the same balanced guard from Image2.

assets.name: Armoured advance
assets.subject: A seamless twelve-pose heavy walk IN PLACE along the given map facing, no whole-sprite translation. 1 left heel contact, 2 left loading, 3 hips over left foot/right heel rises, 4 right passing, 5 right swings forward, 6 right nearly contacts, 7 right heel contact, 8 right loading, 9 hips over right/right support, 10 left passing, 11 left swings forward, 12 left nearly contacts leading smoothly back to1. Small consistent stride with intermediate positions, shoulder counter-swing <=3 pixels, torso bob <=2 pixels at128px. Sword and bow held low steadily, cape trails with gentle lag. No marching exaggerated high knees. Arms/weapons/helmet follow continuous arcs, no stance redesign.

assets.name: Crown judgement
assets.subject: One coherent SWORD-PLANT spell with anticipation and RETURN TO GUARD, not a kneel held forever. Poses1 neutral low guard matching Image2, 2 gauntlets begin closing on sword, 3 sword rises a little, 4 elbows bend and sword lifts, 5 sword reaches compact overhead ready position, 6 poised at full windup. Pose7 is FIRST GROUND CONTACT: plunge sword into ground between feet with short follow-through; no earlier pose contacts ground. Pose8 slight knee compression, 9 begin straightening and withdraw sword, 10 sword lowering, 11 almost at original low guard, 12 returns very close to pose1. Movement stays compact with gradual arm transitions; kneel is shallow. Foreshorten raised blade viewed from above; no elongated blade leaving cell. Bow remains safely slung for plant; reappears naturally at guard. No ground, thorns or explosion drawn.
